visualReview.method: All 20 original PNG captures individually opened and visually inspected at their original 1280x800 or 375x812 resolution.

RU and KK report/DOCX download confirmation
RU and KK Outcomes demonstration labels
RU and KK priority weights in normal and presentation modes

limitations: Viewport captures are not full-page reviews. Some lower-page content requires scrolling.

The mobile navigation is an intentional horizontally scrollable tab strip; the status strip also clips content to its viewport. The original suite verifies navigation reachability and page-level horizontal overflow.

The original public document journey uses its default two-year care value, while the final recorded presentation uses the separately verified three-year example. This suite does not re-record that presentation.

boundaries: No public API, persistence, worker server workflow or Cloudflare proxy-runtime acceptance is inferred from this mock run.

The original runner hardcodes the old publisherReportedSHA a66d542 and null applicationSHA/deploymentId. Its two reports are retained unchanged; current provenance is supplied only by this sidecar and the actual Direct Upload/HTTP byte proof.
The application source was established from the clean build manifest, exact archive upload and 34/34 byte-matching files on each origin, not inferred from a missing deployed-SHA endpoint.
DOCX assertions inspect the downloaded OOXML; this run does not open Microsoft Word.
Screenshots are the original passing test captures; visual review status is recorded separately.
